scalarSpectrumScope.operatorDefinition: thermalDiffusionRate = J*Tbar + B*fixed_point_Dirichlet_temperature; this output is heat power per fluid volume, W/m^3.
scalarSpectrumScope.unitCapacityNormalization: d(Tbar)/dt=(J*Tbar+B*fixed_T)/Cvol only for an independently specified heat equation. The raw audit explicitly used Cvol=1 J/(m^3 K), making the numerical eigenvalues equal to s^-1 values.
scalarSpectrumScope.legacyPerSecondFields: Raw fields whose names contain PerSecond and raw normalized spectral statements apply only to the unit-capacity scalar model; J itself has W/(m^3 K) units.
scalarSpectrumScope.rawVolumeWeightedSymmetricPartUnits: W/K for (V*J+J^T*V)/2; sqrt(V) similarity has W/(m^3 K) units.
scalarSpectrumScope.generalConstantCapacityScaling: For positive constant Cvol in J/(m^3 K), temperature-generator eigenvalues and symmetric parts are divided by Cvol. No such transformation was applied to the reported numerical results.
scalarSpectrumScope.notArtificialGasDefault: The artificial NS gas test has rho*cv=2.5 J/(m^3 K) at rho=1; that value was not silently applied here. This audit supplies no full NS energy time step.
scalarSpectrumScope.boundaryScope: All external and active wall samples are fixed point Dirichlet inputs. These results do not cover zero-gradient or characteristic NS boundary variants.
scalarSpectrumScope.interpretation: Four tested frozen scalar matrices have negative computed rightmost eigenvalues and negative volume-metric symmetric-part maxima. Only sphere_grid8 has a complete dense spectrum; the larger three use two converged ARPACK LR searches plus symmetric-part searches. Negative off-diagonals rule out a general semidiscrete positivity or maximum-principle guarantee.

不跨未解角度带插值，不将60度上限调大后计覆盖；每个面须通过真实剖面、有限外缘、薄层、Kn/Re和流向数值收敛。

需实现沿xi推进的完整耦合方程、轴对称连续方程法向速度及稳定的正向附着支；已有局部BVP不能被改标签当非相似结果。
需流向步长、法向间距/外缘、启动匹配和能量账收敛；同一固定熵外缘下比较局部相似/非相似差异，尤其60~80度。

公开Tauber/Kemp圆点是高焓解离激波管工况，传播激波Mach不是模型Mach；壁温/催化/热化学与传感器平均尚未重建，不能当M4/20km实验精度验证。
